messages.subject: IRF Question
messages.body_plain:
I have a VECM in which there are 2 exogenous I(0) variables.

I add them in the VECM function and the model estimates.

I want to create impulse responses to these 2 exogenous variables.

The irf function generates an error if I include them.

Am I making a mistake?

Thanks for your help.
